note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Jun-Aug (Q2) Shimamura-format same-store sales ran -2.0% (June), -5.1% (July) and +5.3% (August), and all-store sales -1.7/-4.7/+5.8, roughly flat for the quarter against a Q2 last year when group sales rose +5.5%. Q1 SG&A grew +4.8% while gross margin was flat YoY (34.95% vs 34.94%), so Q2 operating profit very likely falls YoY, by roughly 5-10% against 16,150m. In September 2025 a Q2 OP decline of -4% produced a -8.5% gap at the open.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 YoY OP is the line this stock trades at H1. 2025-09-30: Q2 OP -4.0% and H1 about 1.5bn under the market, FY held, gap -8.47% and close -9.48% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8227&b=n202509300365). 2024-10-01: Q2 OP +7.6% and about 0.5bn over consensus, FY held, gap +3.83% and close +6.22% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8227&b=n202410010354). Q1 2026-06-30: OP +16.8%, about 2bn over consensus, gapped +4.2% and closed only +0.8%, which FISCO attributed to the weak June monthly.

findings.finding: The September monthly (Aug 21-Sep 20, the first month of H2), published 2026-09-24, shows same-store sales +10.4% (customers +3.8%, ticket +6.8%), with sales above last year in every region. The stock moved only +0.3% and +0.7% on the two sessions after it, and that month gives management a strong basis for its second-half commentary at the H1 briefing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Shimamura held its full-year guidance at H1 in both 2024 and 2025 and has not raised it at H1 in the kabutan revision history. In 2024 the stock rose +6.2% on an H1 beat, with FISCO citing margin-improvement expectations for H2, so second-half tone carried the reaction even with the guide held.

outside_window.finding: Purchase of the 21 Colmopia clothing stores from Summit, to be converted to Shimamura stores. Completion reported for March next year, so it does not affect H1 or the print.
